# Design notes (v0.1, early beta)

## Records (all generated by `src/plugin/SteelOath.Generator`)

| EditorID | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `SOT_OathQuest` | Quest (start game enabled) | Runs `SOT_OathScript`. Alias 0 `Player` (forced to the player) runs `SOT_PlayerAliasScript`, which forwards `OnSpellCast`, `OnObjectEquipped` and `OnObjectUnequipped`. |
| `SOT_PowerOath` + `SOT_SwearEffect` | Lesser power + script effect | Opens the oath menu (`SOT_PowerEffectScript`). |
| `SOT_Ab<Oath><1-3>` (15) | Abilities | The blessing for each oath at Sworn, Steadfast and Unbroken. |
| `SOT_AbOathbreaker` | Ability | Health −30, Stamina −30 while marked as an oathbreaker. |
| `SOT_Fort*`, `SOT_Oathbreaker*` | Value-modifier magic effects | New effects (Health, Block, DamageResist, Stamina, OneHanded, TwoHanded) so no vanilla effect is reused or changed. |
| `SOT_Active<Oath>`, `SOT_Available<Oath>`, `SOT_ActiveCount`, `SOT_CanSwear` | Globals | Menu button conditions, kept in sync by the script. |
| `SOT_OathsBroken`, `SOT_LongestOathDays`, `SOT_PowerGranted` | Globals | Stats and state. |
| `SOT_MaxOaths` (3), `SOT_Tier2Days` (3), `SOT_Tier3Days` (7), `SOT_PenaltyHours` (24), `SOT_CooldownHours` (72) | Globals | Tunables. |
| `SOT_Msg*` | Messages | Intro, main menu, swear list, renounce list, one confirmation per oath. |

## Detection (vanilla Papyrus only)

| Oath | Event | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Steel | `OnSpellCast` | Breaks if the cast form is a `Scroll`, or a `Spell` equal to `GetEquippedSpell(0)` or `GetEquippedSpell(1)` (left or right hand). Powers and shouts sit in the voice slot, staves cast enchantments, so neither counts. |
| Steel | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks if a `Scroll` is equipped (readied). |
| Shield | `OnObjectUnequipped` | If the unequipped item is an `Armor` with `ArmorShield`, a single 3-second real-time update checks `GetEquippedShield()`. No shield then means broken. Skipped while in werewolf form. |
| Iron | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on an `Armor` with `ArmorLight` (vanilla light shields carry it too). Swearing is refused while `WornHasKeyword(ArmorLight)`. |
| Endurance | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on a `Potion` (potions, food and poisons share that type) while `IsInCombat()`. |
| Close Quarters | `OnObjectEquipped` | Breaks on a `Weapon` with `WeapTypeBow`. Swearing is refused while a bow is equipped. |

All handlers return at once when no oath is active.

## Timing

- Before the power is granted: a 30-second real-time poll that stops once the player is past Helgen and in control.
- After that, there is never a repeating timer. `ScheduleTick()` registers one game-time update for the next moment anything changes (the next blessing tier, the end of a cooldown, the end of the oathbreaker penalty), and nothing at all when no oath or cooldown is pending.

## Scaled down from the concept (documented on purpose)

- **Undetectable vows are left out.** Oaths like mercy (spare those who yield), honesty or "never flee" can't be detected reliably from vanilla Papyrus events: yielding, persuasion outcomes and fleeing don't raise script events on the player. Rather than guess, the mod only offers vows it can check for certain.
- **Spells by school**: telling a Destruction spell from a Restoration spell needs SKSE (`GetNthEffectMagicEffect`), so the Oath of Steel covers all hand-cast spells.
- **Werewolf form**: transforming takes the shield off, so the Shield check is skipped while in beast form. After changing back, re-equip your shield; the oath isn't punished for the transformation.
